args.sql:
SELECT a.name AS agent_name, r.id AS run_id,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS duration_seconds
FROM runs r
JOIN agents a ON r.agent_id = a.id
WHERE r.created_at < '2026-10-28'::date
  AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY duration_seconds DESC
LIMIT 1
